title: Settings
mcp.enabled.label: Enable local MCP
mcp.enabled.sublabel: Listens only on 127.0.0.1 and lets authorized AI clients control playback.
mcp.port.label: Listening port
mcp.port.sublabel: A port conflict prevents MCP from starting but never affects playback itself.
mcp.capabilities.manage.label: Controlled Capabilities & Tools
mcp.modal.title: Controlled Capabilities & Tools
mcp.modal.description: Individually grant or revoke tools and playback controls.
mcp.capability.readStatus.label: Get Playback Status
mcp.capability.readStatus.sublabel: Tool get_playback_status. Allows reading state, position, duration, and volume.
mcp.capability.readTrack.label: Get Now Playing
mcp.capability.readTrack.sublabel: Tool get_now_playing. Allows reading current track title, artist, album, and artwork.
mcp.capability.controlPlay.label: Play Music
mcp.capability.controlPlay.sublabel: Tool play. Allows AI to resume playback.
mcp.capability.controlPause.label: Pause Playback
mcp.capability.controlPause.sublabel: Tool pause. Allows AI to pause playback.
mcp.capability.controlToggle.label: Toggle Playback
mcp.capability.controlToggle.sublabel: Tool toggle_playback. Allows AI to toggle between play and pause.
mcp.capability.controlNext.label: Next Track
mcp.capability.controlNext.sublabel: Tool next_track. Allows AI to play the next track.
mcp.capability.controlPrevious.label: Previous Track
mcp.capability.controlPrevious.sublabel: Tool previous_track. Allows AI to play the previous track.
mcp.capability.controlSeek.label: Seek Position
mcp.capability.controlSeek.sublabel: Tool seek. Allows AI to seek to an absolute millisecond position.
mcp.capability.controlVolume.label: Set Volume
mcp.capability.controlVolume.sublabel: Tool set_volume. Allows AI to set player volume from 0 to 100.
mcp.test.label: Test MCP connection
mcp.test.sublabel: Sends real initialize and tools/list requests to verify that local MCP is usable.
mcp.test.notReady: Enable and save MCP before testing the connection.
mcp.test.failed: MCP connection test failed. Check the service configuration.
mcp.restart.label: Restart service
mcp.restart.sublabel: Restarts the local service using the saved MCP configuration.
mcp.credential.label: Client credential
mcp.credential.sublabel: View and copy client configuration, or regenerate credentials when needed.
mcp.credential.revealFailed: Could not read the latest MCP client configuration
mcp.credential.failed: Could not generate MCP client configuration
mcp.credential.revealedWarning: This is the current valid configuration and can be viewed again later. Generating a new credential invalidates this token immediately.
mcp.credential.copyFailed: Could not copy MCP client configuration
discord.enabled.label: Discord Playback Status
discord.enabled.sublabel: Show the currently playing track in Discord desktop.
discord.applicationId.label: Discord Application ID
discord.applicationId.sublabel: Create a Scopify application in the Discord Developer Portal and enter its Application ID. This value stays on this device.
discord.test.label: Connection Test
discord.test.sublabel: Tests whether the saved Discord settings can connect to Discord desktop on this device.
discord.test.saveFirst: Save the Discord settings before testing
discord.test.disabled: Discord Playback Status is not enabled
discord.test.applicationIdRequired: Enter a valid Discord Application ID
language.label: Interface Language
language.sublabel: Supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English. Default is Simplified Chinese.
appearance.label: Appearance
appearance.sublabel: Switch the Default application theme between light, dark, and system mode. This does not affect Lyric Stage themes.
gpu.label: Hardware Acceleration
gpu.sublabel: Turn this off if the app is slow or the GPU is unstable.
devTools.label: Developer Tools
devTools.sublabel: When enabled, open Developer Tools with Ctrl+Shift+I (⌘⇧I on macOS) and refresh the window with Ctrl+R (⌘R on macOS).
windowClose.label: Window Close Action
windowClose.sublabel: Choose the action when clicking the window close button.
progressRefreshRate.label: Playback Progress Refresh Rate
progressRefreshRate.sublabel: How often the progress bar, Dynamic Island and taskbar lyrics update. Matching the display is smoothest but uses more CPU on high-refresh screens.
logLevel.label: Log Level
logLevel.sublabel: Set the minimum log level saved by the desktop app.
keepDays.label: Keep Days
keepDays.sublabel: Number of days to retain log files.
maxLogSize.label: Per-file Log Limit
maxLogSize.sublabel: Archive the current log by time when it exceeds this size, in MB.
logDirectory.label: Log Storage Location
logDirectory.sublabel: The active storage path for desktop log files.
timeout.label: Timeout (ms)
randomCNIP.label: Use Random CN IPs
randomCNIP.sublabel: Useful for bypassing some geo restrictions.
proxyMode.label: Electron Proxy Mode
proxyMode.sublabel: Applies to Electron window resource requests, and also injects backend API proxy params in custom mode.
proxyUrl.label: Proxy URL
proxyUrl.required: A proxy URL is required when using custom proxy mode.
frontendHost.label: Frontend Host
frontendHost.sublabel: Listen host for Web frontend service during local development.
frontendPort.label: Development Port
frontendPort.sublabel: Listen port for Web frontend service during local development.
localBackend.autoStart.label: Start the local backend on launch
localBackend.autoStart.sublabel: Let Electron launch the local backend; the API target in Network settings stays unchanged and can be switched manually.
localBackend.port.label: Local backend port
localBackend.port.sublabel: Listens on 127.0.0.1 only; an occupied port will not terminate another service.
localBackend.restart.label: Restart bundled backend
localBackend.restart.sublabel: Stops and starts the local backend managed by Scopify.
localBackend.restart.failed: Could not restart the bundled backend
backendProtocol.label: Transport Protocol
backendProtocol.sublabel: Transport protocol used when connecting to backend API (HTTP or HTTPS).
backendHost.label: Backend Host
backendHost.invalid: Invalid backend host format. Please enter a valid IP address or domain name
backendPort.label: Backend Port
backendPort.sublabel: Port on which the backend API listens. Changes take effect immediately after saving, no restart required.
backendPort.invalid: Backend port must be an integer between 1 and 65535
backendUnreachable: Backend service is unreachable at {{url}}. Make sure the backend is running or update the host and port.
backendPing.label: Connection Test
backendPing.sublabel: Send a Ping request to the current address to verify that the remote API is available.
backendPing.invalidResponse: Response is not a valid backend service
confirm.title: Confirm Changes
confirm.subtitle.web: Network settings will take full effect after refreshing the page, while other settings will take effect immediately.
confirm.subtitle.restart: Settings marked with "Restart Required" will take full effect after restarting the application, while other settings will take effect immediately.
confirm.subtitle.instant: Confirm saving changes? All changes will take effect immediately.
updater.manualInstallHint: When an update is available, download the DMG for your Mac’s chip from the release page. Quit Scopify, then replace the old version in Applications.
updater.checkOnStartup.label: Check for Updates on Startup
updater.checkOnStartup.manualHint: Check for new versions on startup and notify you when a download is available.
updater.checkOnStartup.sublabel: Check GitHub Releases for a newer version after the app starts.
updater.autoDownload.label: Download Updates Automatically
updater.autoDownload.sublabel: Start downloading when a new version is found; it installs the next time you quit.
updater.packagedOnly: Automatic updates are available only in an installed desktop build.
cache.dir.label: Cache Directory
cache.dir.sublabel: Leave empty to use the default cache directory.
cache.playbackExplanation: Playback data cache includes temporary playback URLs and lyrics, not audio files.
cache.scope.page.title: Page Cache
cache.scope.page.description: Caches playlist, album, artist, and search data so pages reopen faster.
cache.scope.page.limitDescription: Older page cache data is removed when this limit is reached.
cache.scope.page.ttlDescription: How long playlist, album, and artist data stays cached.
cache.scope.page.searchTtlDescription: Search results change faster, so a shorter time is recommended.
cache.scope.playback.title: Playback Data Cache
cache.scope.playback.description: Caches temporary playback URLs and lyrics, not audio files.
cache.scope.playback.limitDescription: Older playback data is removed when this limit is reached.
cache.scope.playback.maxEntriesDescripti: Maximum number of songs with playback URLs and online lyrics.
cache.scope.playback.urlTtlDescription: How long temporary playback URLs stay valid.
cache.scope.playback.lyricTtlDescription: How long online lyrics stay cached.
cache.cleanup.title: Clear Cache
cache.cleanup.confirm.title: Confirm cache cleanup
cache.cleanup.confirm.description: This will delete {{count}} cached items and free {{size}}.
cache.cleanup.confirm.lyricWarning: The selection includes matched lyrics, imported lyrics, or lyric source choices. They cannot be recovered after deletion.
cache.cleanup.partialFailure: Some cache data could not be cleared. Please try again.
desktopLyrics.enabled.label: Enable Desktop Lyrics
desktopLyrics.enabled.sublabel: Show a standalone floating lyrics window on your desktop.
desktopLyrics.showSecondaryLyric.label: Show Secondary Lyrics
desktopLyrics.showSecondaryLyric.sublabe: Show translated or romanized lyrics below the main lyric line.
desktopLyrics.hideDesktopIcons.label: Hide Windows Desktop Icons
desktopLyrics.hideDesktopIcons.sublabel: Clean desktop at one click, hiding all desktop icons for an undisturbed listening experience.
desktopLyrics.preventSleepOnPlayback.sub: Prevent operating system and display sleep while desktop lyrics are active and music is playing.
desktopLyrics.alwaysOnTop.label: Always on Top
desktopLyrics.alwaysOnTop.sublabel: Keep the desktop lyrics window above all other application windows.
desktopLyrics.locked.label: Lock desktop lyrics
desktopLyrics.locked.sublabel: Locked lyrics can't be moved or resized and let clicks pass through. Hover to reveal the unlock button in the top-right corner.
